text:
[IRET.8.3] **Justification is the emit's, not the rule's.** A firing
records its activation as a justification for the fact each of its logical
emits asserts (`ACTION_LOGICAL_ASSERT`, [IRET.12.1]). An explicit emit
(`ACTION_ASSERT`) records none, whatever else the rule does, and no field of
the terminal changes either.

---

idris.name: iret_10_2__record
idris.note: Recording happens exactly for emits into a `logical` schema, and for nothing else.

idris.name: iret_8_3__record_explicit
idris.note: An explicit emit records nothing, whatever the rule.
